title: One-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken
description: A simple weeknight chicken dinner with lemon, garlic, and herbs.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place chicken and vegetables in a baking dish and coat with the mixture.
Bake until the thickest part of each chicken piece reaches 74°C (165°F), checking with a food thermometer.
Rest briefly and serve hot.
image_alt: Roasted lemon herb chicken with golden vegetables

title: Creamy Tomato Spinach Pasta
description: Comforting pasta with tomato, spinach, and a creamy sauce.
ingredients: 1/3 cup cooking cream or unsweetened plant-based alternative
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; reserve a little pasta water.
Warm olive oil in a pan and cook garlic briefly without browning.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 8–10 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then add cream.
Toss with pasta, loosen with pasta water if needed, season, and serve.
image_alt: Pasta with sauce and fresh herbs

title: Roasted Chickpea Rainbow Bowls
description: A colorful bowl with roasted chickpeas, grains, and fresh vegetables.
instructions: Heat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Pat chickpeas dry, toss with olive oil and paprika, and spread on a tray.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, shaking the tray once.
Divide grains, cucumber, tomato, and greens among bowls.
Top with roasted chickpeas and serve with lemon.
image_alt: Colorful chickpea bowl with fresh vegetables

title: Honey Garlic Salmon Bowls
description: Make a balanced dinner with tender honey-garlic salmon, rice, and crisp vegetables.
instructions: Mix the honey, soy sauce, garlic, and olive oil.
Season the salmon and brush with the sauce.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 12–15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve over rice with cucumber and spoon the remaining cooked sauce over the salmon.
image_alt: Salmon served as a colorful dinner bowl

title: Crispy Black Bean Tacos
description: Crisp-edged black bean tacos with warm spices and fresh toppings for an easy meatless meal.
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed
Lime wedges and salsa, to serve
instructions: Mash half of the black beans with cumin and paprika.
Stir in the remaining beans.
Fill tortillas with the bean mixture and fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp.
Serve with avocado, lettuce, salsa, and lime.
image_alt: Tacos ready to serve with fresh toppings

title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
description: A refreshing chickpea salad with cucumber, tomato, herbs, and a bright lemon dressing.
instructions: Combine chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, feta, and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving, if time allows.
image_alt: Fresh colorful salad with vegetables and greens

title: Easy Roasted Vegetable Pasta
description: Roasted seasonal vegetables and pasta tossed with olive oil, garlic, and Parmesan.
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss zucchini, pepper, onion, and tomatoes with olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Roast for 20–25 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, cook pasta according to its package directions and reserve a little pasta water.
Toss pasta with the roasted vegetables, Parmesan, and a splash of pasta water.
image_alt: Pasta tossed with vegetables and herbs

title: Creamy Lentil Coconut Curry
description: A warming one-pot red lentil curry simmered with coconut milk, tomatoes, and spices.
instructions: Cook the onion in a little oil until softened.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk, and broth.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then season and serve.
image_alt: A warm bowl of curry ready to serve

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
description: Colorful peppers and seasoned chicken roast together for an easy weeknight fajita dinner.
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Arrange chicken, peppers, and onion on a sheet pan.
Toss with olive oil, chili powder, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, stirring halfway, until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) internally.
Serve in warm tortillas with lime wedges.
image_alt: Colorful fajita ingredients prepared for dinner

title: Banana Oat Breakfast Pancakes
description: Simple banana and oat pancakes for a comforting breakfast with everyday ingredients.
ingredients: A little oil for the pan
instructions: Mash the bananas in a bowl.
Whisk in eggs, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and vanilla.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes per side.
Serve warm with fresh fruit.
image_alt: A stack of pancakes served for breakfast

title: Quick Greek Yogurt Parfaits
description: Layer creamy Greek yogurt, crunchy granola, and fresh fruit for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: Spoon a layer of Greek yogurt into four glasses or jars.
Add granola and a layer of fruit.
Repeat the layers until the ingredients are used.
Finish with honey or chia seeds if desired.
Serve immediately for crunchy granola, or keep the granola separate until serving.
image_alt: Yogurt and fruit layered in a breakfast parfait
